steps.player: Hello, what are you doing here?

steps.npc: My name is Jessie. I help look after the forest.

steps.player: Nice to meet you. You must know this area very well then.

steps.npc: I do. There're all sorts of interesting creatures around here. Be careful, some of them are not very friendly. A lot of travellers have become their victims.

steps.player: I see. Thanks for the warning.

steps.npc: No problem! Safe travels my friend.
